response.rationale: R3 uniquely matches the pathognomonic histologic triad of Kikuchi-Fujimoto disease: coagulative necrosis with karyorrhexis, lymphoplasmacytoid infiltrate, and tender lymphadenopathy with fever. R1 lacks the necrotizing features and would show different histology.

rejected.why: Lacks the characteristic coagulative necrosis with karyorrhexis; Castleman disease histology is different.
Sarcoidosis would show non-caseating granulomas, not coagulative necrosis with karyorrhexis.
Rosai-Dorfman disease would show emperipolesis, not coagulative necrosis with karyorrhexis.
